threads.body: `AgentInvocation` is the return type of the public `TelemetryHandler.invoke_*_agent()` APIs. Removing the `provider` constructor parameter is a breaking change for any callers that were constructing `AgentInvocation` directly (even though the module is private) and for any internal uses that may still pass it positionally/by name. If the goal is only to stop emitting `gen_ai.provider.name`, consider keeping an optional `provider` parameter for backward compatibility but not including it in span/metric attributes.
